# EmpireCharme

> EmpireCharme is a premium beauty salon on Moe Kaung Road, Yankin Township, Yangon, offering hair, scalp, nail and grooming services.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Salon overview, specialties and highlights.
- [About](/about): Our story, values and philosophy of healthy hair care.
- [Services](/services): Hair, treatments, nails and grooming services.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, opening hours and map.
